# Senior Machine Learning Engineer

**Ravnekær Mobility** · Copenhagen (hybrid) · 1 position

Ravnekær runs shared e-bikes and scooters in five Nordic cities. Our models decide where
vehicles should be in the next hour. We are looking for a senior machine learning engineer
to take them from notebooks to reliable services.

## What you will do

- Design, train and ship deep learning models for demand and rebalancing.
- Serve models as services and keep them healthy in production.
- Set standards for testing, monitoring and retraining.

## What we are looking for

- At least 5 years of software or machine learning engineering.
- Excellent Python and good engineering habits.
- Hands-on PyTorch.
- Experience putting deep learning models into production.
- Docker and containerised deployments.
- You have built model APIs, ideally with FastAPI.
- You must be allowed to work in the EU.

## Nice to have

- Databricks or another Spark platform.
- PySpark for large feature pipelines.

We offer a yearly learning budget, a free ride pass and a team that ships every week.
